harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock on node1 and locked curl at its currently installed version (curl-7.76.1-31.el9). Verified the lock survives a real full-system dnf update (210 packages upgraded, kernel included) and a subsequent node reboot — curl stayed pinned at 7.76.1-31.el9 while a newer curl (7.76.1-40.el9_8.7) was confirmed available upstream and excluded from the transaction.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: curl-7.76.1-31.el9 installed, versionlock plugin absent, recorded initial boot_id
Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock via sudo dnf install
Ran dnf versionlock add curl to pin curl at 7.76.1-31.el9
Confirmed via repoquery that newer curl builds (7.76.1-40.el9, el9_8.5, el9_8.7) exist in repos, making the lock test meaningful
Ran a full dnf update -y --assumeno dry-run (210 packages) and confirmed curl was absent from the transaction
Executed the real dnf update -y, which upgraded 210 packages including the kernel, and verified curl remained at 7.76.1-31.el9 with the versionlock entry intact

Performed mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued shutdown -r now in background so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime was 0 minutes
Post-restart verification: curl still 7.76.1-31.el9, versionlock entry still present, and a fresh dry-run update confirms curl remains excluded

evidence.requirement: Baseline curl version and lack of prior version lock on node1
evidence.summary: curl-7.76.1-31.el9.x86_64 installed; versionlock plugin not yet installed; baseline boot_id captured

evidence.requirement: Version lock installed and applied to curl
evidence.summary: Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock; ran dnf versionlock add curl; versionlock list shows curl-0:7.76.1-31.el9.*; targeted curl update dry-run reports Nothing to do

evidence.requirement: Confirm a newer curl exists upstream so the lock is meaningfully tested, and that curl is excluded from a full update transaction
evidence.summary: repoquery shows curl-7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 available; full update dry-run transaction list (210 packages, kernel etc.) does not include curl

evidence.requirement: Explicit confirmation curl excluded from transaction, and real update leaves curl untouched
evidence.summary: grep confirms curl absent from update transaction; real dnf update -y ran (kernel and 210 packages upgraded); post-update rpm -q curl still shows 7.76.1-31.el9; versionlock list still shows the lock

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline before mandatory reboot
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc, confirmed curl still locked at 7.76.1-31.el9, issued backgrounded shutdown -r now so ack returned
Connection timed out confirms node1 was mid-reboot/unreachable

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving genuine restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 09d077fb-c3e0-43bb-8f9d-150e7b6325af with uptime 0 min, proving a real reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery verification of curl pin
evidence.summary: After reboot, rpm -q curl still 7.76.1-31.el9, versionlock list still shows the lock, and dry-run update confirms curl remains excluded
